sentences.text: After discussion and hearing Counsel appearing for both parties and after perusing the relevant record, we are of the opinion that the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal is on lower side and deserves to be enhanced by Rs.2,05,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Five Thousand Only).

We,
therefore, suggest the parties that the matter may be settled on these lines.
Accepting our suggestion, the parties have entered into a settlement and have filed an application duly signed by the representatives of the parties.
The compromise between the parties is verified.
It is just, valid and lawful.
It is, therefore, ordered to be recorded.

Accordingly, an award is passed in the following terms:-
( a ) That Respondent-Insurance Company shall pay a sum of Rs.2,05,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Five Thousand Only) without interest, in addition to the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal as full and final satisfaction of the claim made by the appellant(s) in this appeal.
The remaining findings of the MACT in the award shall remain intact.

( b ) That Respondent-Insurance Company shall deposit the aforesaid amount in the Claims Tribunal for payment to the appellant(s) within a period of three months from today, failing which this additional amount shall be recoverable with interest calculated at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of this award.
(c) On deposit being made, Claims Tribunal shall permit appellant/s to withdraw the same.

(d) Since the matter has been settled between the parties in this National Lok Adalat,
the Court fees, if any, paid by the claimant(s) be refunded on issuing certificate by the Registry.
(e) This appeal is finally disposed of and the parties to bear their own costs.
(f) The copy of the application filed by the parties be kept in the record of this appeal.
(g) Copy of the award be given to both the parties free of charges.
(JUSTICE VIVEK RUSIA)

opennyai_summary.decision:
After discussion and hearing Counsel appearing for both parties and after perusing the relevant record, we are of the opinion that the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal is on lower side and deserves to be enhanced by Rs.2,05,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Five Thousand Only).
We,
therefore, suggest the parties that the matter may be settled on these lines.
Accepting our suggestion, the parties have entered into a settlement and have filed an application duly signed by the representatives of the parties.
The compromise between the parties is verified.
It is just, valid and lawful.
It is, therefore, ordered to be recorded.
Accordingly, an award is passed in the following terms:-
( a ) That Respondent-Insurance Company shall pay a sum of Rs.2,05,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Five Thousand Only) without interest, in addition to the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal as full and final satisfaction of the claim made by the appellant(s) in this appeal.
The remaining findings of the MACT in the award shall remain intact.
( b ) That Respondent-Insurance Company shall deposit the aforesaid amount in the Claims Tribunal for payment to the appellant(s) within a period of three months from today, failing which this additional amount shall be recoverable with interest calculated at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of this award.
(c) On deposit being made, Claims Tribunal shall permit appellant/s to withdraw the same.
(d) Since the matter has been settled between the parties in this National Lok Adalat,
the Court fees, if any, paid by the claimant(s) be refunded on issuing certificate by the Registry.
(e) This appeal is finally disposed of and the parties to bear their own costs.
(f) The copy of the application filed by the parties be kept in the record of this appeal.
(g) Copy of the award be given to both the parties free of charges.
